thread:
maria: Hey team, customer ACME-99 opened a support case — their daily CSV export is missing rows for 2026-02-14, 2026-02-15, and 2026-02-16. Dashboard shows normal usage those days but the CSV file has zeros. They need corrected exports for billing recon.
ashwin: Thanks @maria. Do we have the export manifest path and a sample CSV? Can you paste the manifest S3 path and the customer's account id as it appears in the export? :eyes:
maria: Manifest: `s3://redwood-usage-exports/prod/2026/02/14/manifest.json` (similar paths for the 15/16 dirs). Customer id in metadata: `acme-99`. Attached a 10-line preview they sent — basically empty day rows.
ashwin: pulling manifest now. Quick sanity SQL to confirm dashboard numbers:
```sql
SELECT date_trunc('day', ts) AS day, sum(tokens) AS total_tokens
FROM usage_events
WHERE customer_id = 'acme-99'
  AND ts BETWEEN '2026-02-14' AND '2026-02-16'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;
```
ashwin: SQL returns non-zero tokens for all three days, so ingestion and aggregation look fine. That points to the export generator or the manifest that enumerates shards.
maria: Customer says the file they downloaded had the right filename but only header rows. They grabbed it at 10:30 UTC on 2026-02-17.
ashwin: Checked the manifest at `s3://redwood-usage-exports/prod/2026/02/14/manifest.json` — it lists 12 shard files but shards 04-06 are missing entries in the manifest (there are placeholders but no s3 keys). Example manifest snippet:
```json
{
  "shards": [
    "shard-00.csv",
    "shard-01.csv",
    "shard-02.csv",
    "shard-03.csv",
    null,
    null,
    null,
    "shard-07.csv"
  ]
}
```
ashwin: Export job logs show a downstream step failed when writing the manifest for shards 04-06. Error in logs: `JSONDecodeError at exporter/manifest_writer.py: line 82` and then `ValueError: invalid control character at position 0` when trying to serialize a sample event. Looks like one event payload contained an unescaped control char and broke the manifest generator, which left placeholder nulls.
kevin: assigning to eng-runtime to own the replay/backfill. @ashwin can you capture the exact log trace and the offending event id? We need to sanitize the serializer and decide whether to re-run a full export or just the missing shards.
ashwin: Got the trace, event id `evt_20260214_9f3b`. Log snippet:
```
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "exporter/manifest_writer.py", line 82, in write_manifest
    json.dumps(shard_list)
ValueError: Invalid control character at: '\u0007' in field payload -> evt_20260214_9f3b
```
ashwin: Quick repro: I fetched the raw event and printed repr(payload) and it contains `\x07`. So the exporter crashed mid-manifest write and left nulls.
maria: Customer asked for ETA and a temporary fix. Can we produce a one-off CSV for the three missing days ASAP so their billing team can reconcile?
kevin: Plan:
1) eng-runtime will run a targeted shard export for `acme-99` for 2026-02-14..16 with a sanitizer that strips control chars and writes to a presigned S3 path. (owner: kevin)
2) analytics will generate a reconciled CSV and confirm token counts match DB aggregation. (owner: ashwin)
3) infra will deploy a manifest-writer patch to handle bad payloads without failing the whole manifest. (eng-runtime will follow up with PR link)
kevin: I'll kick off the one-off now. ETA 2 hours for presigned link. Also opening ENG issue: RH-EXPORT-422.
ashwin: After the one-off, we should schedule a backfill job to re-run the exporter over the impacted date range so the canonical daily exports reflect corrected shard files. Backfill window: tonight 02:00 UTC to avoid peak.
maria: Customer communicated — they need the CSV by EOD. Please copy me on the presigned link when ready. I'll tell them we're generating a one-off and will follow up once backfill completes.
export-bot: deploy-notice: export-sanitizer v1.0.1 deployed to prod-candidates at 2026-03-01T18:05Z. CI: passed. :white_check_mark:
kevin: pre-signed link uploaded: `https://s3-presigned.redwood/oneoffs/acme-99-2026-02-14-16.csv?token=...` — shared with case. Starting backfill at 02:05 UTC; I'll post status here when it's done or if we hit further errors.
maria: Thanks — forwarding to the customer. Keeping this thread open until the backfill completes and the daily export reflects the corrected files. :thumbsup:
